app_tagline: Your Immich albums as TV shows in Jellyfin and Kodi
auth_intro: Sign in as the Immich user that albums are shared with for the media server.
auth_password_hint: The password is checked by Immich and not stored. The app keeps its own Immich key, only for naming people and accepting invitations.
auth_with_key: Sign in with an API key
auth_key_hint: For an Immich that signs in only through OAuth. Without the permissions person.update and clusterGroupRequest.create the page can show people but not name them.
error_secret_key_missing: Signing in is not set up: SHOWRUNNER_SECRET_KEY is missing in .env.
error_not_the_app_user: Only the Immich user whose API key the app syncs with can sign in.
error_immich_invalid_api_key: Immich does not accept this API key.
error_immich_password_login_failed: Immich did not let in with a password; it may sign in only through OAuth. Use an API key.
status_interval: The app syncs every {minutes} min, and fully once an hour.
status_held_text: It would remove {removed} of {before} links. That looks like a wrong API key or user rather than albums that are no longer shared, so nothing was changed.
status_force_text: {removed} of {before} links will be removed from the folders of the media servers, with their shows. The videos in Immich are not touched, and the shows come back when the albums are shared again.
status_skipped_hint: These videos of shared albums did not become episodes.
skip_no_path_mapping: its folder is not in SHOWRUNNER_PATH_MAP
status_pictures_hint: They are tried again on the next pass.
status_foreign_hint: Something the app did not write is at these paths of the output folder, so it did not overwrite or remove it.
shows_hint: Every album shared with the user of the app becomes a show in the media server. Open one to change how it looks there: its title, its seasons and its episodes.
shows_empty_text: Share an album with videos with the Immich user of the app.
show_title_hint: Empty: the name of the album, “{name}”.
show_seasons_hint: Changing this gives the episodes new numbers; their watched marks may be lost. Slideshows are made again: one season makes them for the whole album, not by year.
show_hide: Leave this album out of the media server
show_saved: Saved. The media server will have it in a minute.
episode_reset: Back to the title and order from Immich
episode_hide: Leave out of the media server
episode_show: Show in the media server again
people_hint: People shared with the user of the app in Immich. Only those with a name here are in the media server, marked with the prefix; the names of the owners stay as they are.
people_read_only: Signed in with an API key without the permissions to name people: names can be changed in Immich, descriptions here.
people_group_unknown: Not known: sign in with the password to see it.
people_group_members: The user of the app is in a group with: {names}.
people_group_alone: The user of the app is in no group with others yet: nobody can share people with it.
people_group_hint: Only members of one group can share people. A user is in one group only: all owners whose people should be in the media server have to be in the same group.
people_invitation_blocked: The user of the app is already in a group with others. Joining another group takes it out of the current one, and the people shared there are lost for the media server. If that is what you want, accept it in Immich.
people_empty_text: An owner of albums shares people with the user of the app in Immich: People, a person, Manage access.
people_name_hint: Written to Immich for the user of the app only. Empty: the person is not in the media server.
people_description_hint: Shown on the page of the person in Jellyfin; Kodi does not show descriptions of people. Kept by the app; Immich has no such field.
error_cannot_write: This sign-in can not change Immich. Sign in with the password.
error_sign_in_again: Immich did not accept the key of the app. Sign out and sign in again.
error_show_not_found: This album is not shared with the user of the app.
styles_intro: Each album gets the pictures of its show — poster, landscape picture, backdrop, logo and season posters — in a style chosen at random from those switched on here. Albums in a style you switch off get another one on the next sync, unless their pictures are frozen.
styles_saved: Saved. The pictures change with the next sync, in a few minutes.
artwork_saved: Saved. The media server gets the new pictures with the next sync, in a few minutes.
artwork_none_yet: No pictures yet: they are drawn once the frames of the videos are looked at, within a few syncs. Until then the poster is the cover of the album.
artwork_drawing: Drawing… this takes a few seconds.
artwork_pinned_hint: A pinned picture stays exactly as it is when videos are added or removed, and when the style or the frames of the others change.
artwork_waiting: Looking at the videos of the album: {count} left. Until then the pictures are drawn from the videos looked at so far.
artwork_redrawing: Drawing the new pictures. They appear here when the sync is done; this may take a few minutes.
error_style_last: At least one style has to stay switched on.
error_artwork_not_ready: The videos of this album are not looked at yet. Try again after the next sync.
error_artwork_failed: The frames could not be read from Immich. Try again.
error_artwork_slot: There is no such picture, or it is pinned.
slideshow_intro: The photos of an album become videos with music, one for each year, among the specials of its show in Jellyfin and Kodi.
slideshow_enabled_hint: The first time, a large library takes hours: the slideshows appear one by one as they are drawn, the newest years first.
slideshow_credits: Credits at the end: the music and “Made with Showrunner for Immich”
slideshow_credits_hint: The music is always named in the description of the episode.
slideshow_no_data: The data folder of the app is not set (SHOWRUNNER_DATA_DIR): slideshows can not be drawn.
slideshow_saved: Saved. The next sync plans the slideshows; they appear as they are drawn.
music_set_intro: Free music chosen for family albums (CC BY, CC0). It is downloaded with the first slideshow. A piece switched off is not used.
music_own_intro: Add your own pieces: MP3, M4A, OGG, FLAC or WAV, 30 seconds to 15 minutes, up to 50 MB. Title, author and licence are optional; what you give is named in the description and the credits.
music_own_rights: The rights to the music you add are yours.
music_none_own: No music of your own yet.
album_slideshow_off_global: Slideshows are switched off. Switch them on on the Slideshows page.
album_slideshow_wistful_hint: Wistful music is chosen only here, never by itself.
album_slideshow_none: No slideshows yet: a year needs at least 6 photos, and new photos are looked at during the next syncs.
album_slideshow_state_older: Being drawn again; the previous one is shown meanwhile
album_slideshow_saved: Saved. The next sync draws the slideshows again; until then the current ones stay.
error_slideshow_not_found: This slideshow is not drawn yet.
error_no_data_dir: The data folder of the app is not set.
error_music_not_found: There is no such piece of music.
error_music_set_fixed: Pieces of the music set can only be switched on or off.
error_music_file_type: This is not a music file the app takes (MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, OPUS, FLAC, WAV).
error_music_exists: A piece with this name is there already.
error_music_too_large: The file is larger than {megabytes} MB.
error_music_not_usable: This is no music for slideshows: {reason}
status_slideshows: {drawn} drawn in the last sync, {waiting} waiting
album_slideshow_reason_scene: did not fit in twenty minutes
album_slideshow_not_looked: {count} photos not looked at yet (they come in the next syncs)
album_slideshow_trash_hint: A slideshow drawn again or removed is kept here for a while, then deleted.
slideshow_plan_intro: How the photos were chosen, day by day and scene by scene. Framed: shown. Beside a framed photo on the same grey: its near copies. Faded: did not fit in the twenty minutes of the season (each day gets its share). Click a photo to see it larger.
slideshow_plan_redrawing: The slideshow is still being drawn again: this is the plan it will be drawn by.
slideshow_plan_none: No plan yet: it comes with the next sync.
